tools.description: Basic QC on an image nobody has QC'd, without a model: the Artifact Detector (tissue folds -- also ones that come or go between imaging cycles -- tears, debris, saturated pixels) written at its default thresholds as automatic, unreviewed regions, and DNA retention where the image has a DNA channel per cycle and a mask; the cells inside are excluded. A job (job_wait). An image with a QC result already is left alone; the full QC (qc_session_start, or the QC panel) reviews these regions. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt.

force.description: Run the checks again even when their results for this image are stored.

descriptor.purpose: Basic QC on an image nobody has QC'd, without a model: the Artifact Detector (tissue folds -- also ones that come or go between imaging cycles -- tears, debris, saturated pixels) written at its default thresholds as automatic, unreviewed regions, and DNA retention where the image has a DNA channel per cycle and a mask; the cells inside are excluded. A job (job_wait). An image with a QC result already is left alone; the full QC (qc_session_start, or the QC panel) reviews these regions.

tools.description: Find out-of-focus regions without a model: multi-scale gradient energy (Tenengrad) per tile of the tissue at a fixed analysis resolution, against the image's own sharpest tiles, as a 0-1 Blur Score with an automatic threshold and a whole-image blur warning, for each listed DNA channel (default the first three nuclear ones) or the ones given. A job (job_wait); a channel whose image and parameters are unchanged is reused. Nothing is written to the ROIs. Read-only.

analysis_um_px.description: The resolution the image is read at, µm per pixel (default 0.5).

cell_um.description: A grid cell's side in microns (default 40; each score covers 3 x 3 cells).

reference_fraction.description: The share of the sharpest cells that make the in-image sharp reference (default 0.15).

channel.description: A channel of the image (the one to act on). Default: every listed channel for a run, status or write; the first listed for a set. Ignored on brightfield (the darkness plane).

channels.description: Run these (and list them). Default: the listed channels -- the ones picked, else the first three nuclear ones.

force.description: Run again even if a result for these inputs is stored.

descriptor.purpose: Find out-of-focus regions without a model: multi-scale gradient energy (Tenengrad) per tile of the tissue at a fixed analysis resolution, against the image's own sharpest tiles, as a 0-1 Blur Score with an automatic threshold and a whole-image blur warning, for each listed DNA channel (default the first three nuclear ones) or the ones given. A job (job_wait); a channel whose image and parameters are unchanged is reused. Nothing is written to the ROIs.

tools.description: Find physical artifacts without a model, across every channel: tissue folds, tears and detached tissue, debris and fibers on the glass round the section, and saturated (clipped) pixels per channel -- coarse to fine, each a snug outline with a 0-1 score, the channels it shows in and the one it shows most. A job (job_wait); reused when the image and parameters are unchanged. Needs a pixel size. Nothing is written to the ROIs. Read-only.

categories.description: The categories to look for (default all four).

debris_z.description: Compact debris' least brightness over the glass, robust SDs (default 3).

feather_um.description: How far past the tissue edge the search reaches (default 100).

fold_z.description: A fold seed's least brightness over the tissue, robust SDs (default 2.5).

grow_um.description: How far the fine pass may grow an object past its coarse seed (default 150).

pan_channels.description: Channels averaged into the pan image the objects are traced on (default 8: one nuclear per cycle, then markers evenly spaced).

pixel_um.description: Microns per pixel at full resolution, when the image does not say (every size the detector uses is in microns).

tear_level.description: A tear holds at most this share of the tissue's signal over the glass (default 0.35), or is darker in most channels.

tissue_min_width_um.description: Tissue narrower than this (a peeled ribbon) is left out of the analysis region (default 200).

force.description: Run again even if a result for these inputs is stored.

params.description: Detection parameters (default: the detector's own; each is in microns or robust SDs).

descriptor.purpose: Find physical artifacts without a model, across every channel: tissue folds, tears and detached tissue, debris and fibers on the glass round the section, and saturated (clipped) pixels per channel -- coarse to fine, each a snug outline with a 0-1 score, the channels it shows in and the one it shows most. A job (job_wait); reused when the image and parameters are unchanged. Needs a pixel size. Nothing is written to the ROIs.

tools.description: Check the segmentation mask against the DNA stain: every cell is scored for under-segmentation (one label, several nuclei) and over-segmentation (one nucleus split across labels), judged against its own neighbourhood so dense tissue is not over-called. A job (job_wait); reused when the image, mask, DNA channel and parameters are unchanged. The mask is never modified. Read-only.

flag.description: A score at or above this flags a cell (default 0.6).

unsure.description: Between this and `flag` a cell is ambiguous (default 0.4).

dna_channel.description: Default: the one chosen before, else the first nuclear channel.

force.description: Run again even if a result for these inputs is stored.

descriptor.purpose: Check the segmentation mask against the DNA stain: every cell is scored for under-segmentation (one label, several nuclei) and over-segmentation (one nucleus split across labels), judged against its own neighbourhood so dense tissue is not over-called. A job (job_wait); reused when the image, mask, DNA channel and parameters are unchanged. The mask is never modified.

tools.description: A project's QC: every channel's status, every QC region (category, subtype, action, score and threshold with its source, the agent's judgment, who made it, the user's edits), a summary per category, the cells' pass/fail counts by reason with where each came from, the strictness, the provenance. Read this first. Read-only.

detail.description: brief: counts, categories, regions, cell reasons and each check's bar; full: also every histogram and quantile, each region's cell propagation and each call's raw evidence.

include_cells.description: Also list failing cell ids, and the cells with an unreliable marker (bounded).

include_regions.description: Every QC region with its category, subtype (class), action, score, threshold and threshold_source, and the agent's judgment.

max_ids.description: With include_cells: at most this many cell ids per list.

descriptor.purpose: A project's QC: every channel's status, every QC region (category, subtype, action, score and threshold with its source, the agent's judgment, who made it, the user's edits), a summary per category, the cells' pass/fail counts by reason with where each came from, the strictness, the provenance. Read this first.

tools.description: Segmentation QC's summary: cells and area under- / over-segmented (percentages kept apart), the DNA channel, whether the result is stale, and a running job's progress. Read-only.

include_regions.description: Also where the flagged cells cluster (GeoJSON, full-resolution pixels), at the cluster map's automatic bar.

descriptor.purpose: Segmentation QC's summary: cells and area under- / over-segmented (percentages kept apart), the DNA channel, whether the result is stale, and a running job's progress.

planes.description: contours: {plane index: GeoJSON Polygon in image pixels}.

rz.description: ellipsoid: half its depth, in planes.

base_revision.description: The revision last read; refused if the regions changed since.

category.description: Category label; created if the project has none by that name (matched case-insensitively).

cells.description: On a z-stack with a 3-D mask: make the region exactly these cells (label ids, which are the table's cell ids), outlined plane by plane from the mask -- instead of geometry or points.

extent.description: On a z-stack: the planes the region covers (default: all).

geometry.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon, in image pixels, instead of points.

method.description: Which tool drew the shape, recorded as provenance.

points.description: One ring of [x, y] vertices in full-resolution image pixels.

solid.description: On a z-stack: its shape through the planes (sets the planes it covers too).

t.description: With `cells`: the frame of a time series.

method.description: With a new outline: which tool drew it.

tools.description: Render a region of a project's image as the viewer draws it -- chosen channels and windows, the cell mask as outlines or fill, cells a gate calls positive highlighted, cell ids, a scale bar -- deterministically, from the source pyramid, without touching the viewer. Regions by pixel box, by centre and size in µm, or by ROI. Read-only. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn.

Bounds.description: A rectangle in full-resolution image pixels, top-left origin.

label_ids.description: Write cell ids next to cells in the field (bounded by max_labels, nearest the centre first).

qc_failures.description: With a marker highlight: muted draws the cells QC left out of estimation for that marker in qc_color and never as positive (the manifest counts them); as_others draws them like every other cell.

CenterBounds.description:
A square (or rectangle) around a point: in microns when the image is
calibrated, else in pixels.

size_um.description: Side in microns (needs a calibrated image).

cofactor.description: asinh only: raw units above black where the curve turns from linear to logarithmic. Default the window's span / 20.

kind.description: 'linear', or 'asinh': log-like above the cofactor, so dim cells show above background while bright ones keep their structure.

curve.description: How brightness follows intensity. Default: the calibration's curve for an 'auto' window, else linear.

name.description: Channel name (or key), as `list_channels` gives it.

window.description: [low, high] in raw intensity units; 'auto' (the project's display calibration when one is stored, else the channel's 1st-99.9th percentile); or 'percentiles' (always the 1st-99.9th percentile).

MarkerHighlight.description:
Colour cells by a marker gate: positive cells in one colour, the rest in
another (or undrawn).

padding.description: Margin, as a fraction of the box's larger side.

roi_id.description: A region's id from `list_rois`; the render frames its bounding box.

ShapeSpec.description:
A region to draw over the picture: a GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon or a
box, in full-resolution image pixels (a QC candidate's outline, a grid
square).

geometry.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon, full-resolution pixels.

bounds.description: The region, in full-resolution pixels. Give one of bounds, center or roi; none means the whole image.

channels.description: Channels to composite (default from the preset, else the first three).

layers.description: The scene's other layers to draw over the image: 'visible' (as the viewer shows them), 'none', or a list of layer ids.

level.description: Pyramid level, or 'auto' for the cheapest one with enough detail.

marker.description: Shortcut: show this marker's channel and highlight cells its stored gate calls positive.

scale_bar.description: Draw a scale bar (only when calibrated).

segmentation.description: How to draw the cell mask (default: outlines when there is one).

shapes.description: Regions to outline over the picture (GeoJSON or boxes, full-resolution pixels).

view.description: For a z-stack (inspect_volume): which plane or projection to draw -- 'z12' (plane 12), 'z4-19max' (maximum projection of planes 4-19, inclusive), 'zmean', 'z2-8p95'; 't3z12' for a frame. Default: the plane the image opens on. The manifest's `view` says which was drawn; a projection's overlap is not colocalization.

descriptor.purpose: Render a region of a project's image as the viewer draws it -- chosen channels and windows, the cell mask as outlines or fill, cells a gate calls positive highlighted, cell ids, a scale bar -- deterministically, from the source pyramid, without touching the viewer. Regions by pixel box, by centre and size in µm, or by ROI.

tools.description: A grid of single-cell crops -- each cell centred and outlined, its id and marker value under it -- for given cells, or the positive, negative, borderline (nearest the gate), brightest or dimmest cells of a marker. The borderline gallery is the most useful gating view. Read-only. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn.

cell_ids.description: These cells (the first n). Or give marker + select.

channels.description: Channels to draw (default the nuclear channel and the marker).

crop_px.description: Crop side in full-resolution pixels (default 160 when uncalibrated).

crop_um.description: Crop side in µm (default 40; needs a calibrated image).

marker.description: The marker whose value is under each cell, and that select picks by.

qc.description: QC failures left out of this estimate, sample or picture (the gate still applies to every cell). strict (default): cells QC called exclude or warn, and the cells QC flagged this marker unreliable in; exclude: warn calls kept; off: QC ignored (only when the user asks).

select.description: positive / negative (by the gate, brightest first), borderline (nearest the gate), brightest, dimmest.

sort_by.description: For cell_ids: the order (default by marker value, brightest first).

tile_px.description: Each tile's side in the picture.

descriptor.purpose: A grid of single-cell crops -- each cell centred and outlined, its id and marker value under it -- for given cells, or the positive, negative, borderline (nearest the gate), brightest or dimmest cells of a marker. The borderline gallery is the most useful gating view.

tools.description: One cell explained: every marker's value and percentile, its strongest markers, the regions it lies in, its nearest neighbours with distances, a crop with it outlined, and what QC says of it (left out or not, the markers it is not called for, and why). Read-only. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn.

cell_id.description: The cell's id, as the table's id column has it.

include_metadata.description: Every metadata column's value too (one read per column; slow on a remote table).

marker.description: A marker to focus on: drawn in the crop and reported for each neighbour.

qc.description: QC failures left out of this estimate, sample or picture (the gate still applies to every cell). strict (default): cells QC called exclude or warn, and the cells QC flagged this marker unreliable in; exclude: warn calls kept; off: QC ignored (only when the user asks).

within_um.description: Only neighbours this close (needs a calibrated image).

descriptor.purpose: One cell explained: every marker's value and percentile, its strongest markers, the regions it lies in, its nearest neighbours with distances, a crop with it outlined, and what QC says of it (left out or not, the markers it is not called for, and why).

tools.description: One job's status, progress and, once done, result. Read-only.

job_id.description: The job_id a job-running capability returned.

descriptor.purpose: One job's status, progress and, once done, result.

tools.description: Wait for a job to finish (up to timeout_s), reporting its progress as it goes; returns the job, finished or not. Read-only.

job_id.description: The job_id a job-running capability returned.

timeout_s.description: How long to wait at most; call again if it is still running.

descriptor.purpose: Wait for a job to finish (up to timeout_s), reporting its progress as it goes; returns the job, finished or not.

tools.description: Undo one earlier write by its operation_id: replays the receipt's undo hint, receipted like any write. Refused when the state has changed since, when it was already undone, or when the operation was not reversible. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt.

expected_current_revision.description: Undo even though the store changed since this operation, provided its revision is exactly this now -- for undoing a run of writes newest first, where each undo moves the revision the next one was receipted against.

operation_id.description: The receipt's operation_id, as a write returned it or the audit log records it.

descriptor.purpose: Undo one earlier write by its operation_id: replays the receipt's undo hint, receipted like any write. Refused when the state has changed since, when it was already undone, or when the operation was not reversible.

tools.description: Gate the project's markers or quality-control its image with Plexora AI, inside Plexora: the session runs on a job and every decision is a model call, paid from the organisation's AI credit wallet. The run is quoted before anything is spent (ai_balance's estimate: the price per marker or channel times their number) and the quote is a ceiling -- up to that many credits: each call is metered and the run is charged what its calls cost, never more. An open viewer's agent panel shows it. Resume a session paused for credit with resume_session. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

channels.description: qc: the channels (default: every channel of the image).

context.description: gating: the user's note about the sample, as typed ("melanoma from skin", "only gate CD3 and CD8"): read into the session's biology, narrowing the markers only when it says so.

dev.description: The gateway's dev route (internal testing accounts only).

kind.description: gating: Auto Gating of the markers; contrast: how bright each marker is drawn, no gating; qc: AutoQC of the image.

markers.description: gating, contrast: the markers (default: every marker of the table).

mode.description: apply: gates / regions are written as they are decided; propose: nothing is written until the session is committed.

model.description: With dev only: the model to use.

parallel_markers.description: gating: markers answered side by side, each lane its own workers; the gates are the serial run's.

resume_session.description: Continue this paused session (after a credit pause, say) instead of starting one.

start_options.description: Extra options for the session's start (the workflow's own, e.g. QC's map_cell_um).

units_per_worker.description: Units one rolling worker covers (default: 1 marker, 4 QC units).

descriptor.purpose: Gate the project's markers or quality-control its image with Plexora AI, inside Plexora: the session runs on a job and every decision is a model call, paid from the organisation's AI credit wallet. The run is quoted before anything is spent (ai_balance's estimate: the price per marker or channel times their number) and the quote is a ceiling -- up to that many credits: each call is metered and the run is charged what its calls cost, never more. An open viewer's agent panel shows it. Resume a session paused for credit with resume_session.

tools.description: A Plexora AI run: its state, the session it drives, packets, credits charged and the cache-read share; or the recent runs. Read-only. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

run_id.description: A run id (air_...) or the job id that runs it (job_...). Omit to list the recent runs.

descriptor.purpose: A Plexora AI run: its state, the session it drives, packets, credits charged and the cache-read share; or the recent runs.

tools.description: Pause, resume or stop a running Plexora AI run's session (what it wrote stays). Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

action.description: pause the session at its next packet (the run waits) / resume it; stop it (what it wrote so far stays, undoable). A run paused for credit is resumed with ai.run_session(resume_session=...) instead.

run_id.description: A run id (air_...) or its job id (job_...).

descriptor.purpose: Pause, resume or stop a running Plexora AI run's session (what it wrote stays).

tools.description: The organisation's AI credit wallet (every product's AI draws on it), the price per marker / channel, and what a Plexora AI run of a project would be quoted: up to that many credits, charged as metered. Read-only. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

kind.description: The run to estimate; both: every kind.

project.description: Estimate a run of this project too.

descriptor.purpose: The organisation's AI credit wallet (every product's AI draws on it), the price per marker / channel, and what a Plexora AI run of a project would be quoted: up to that many credits, charged as metered.

tools.description: Gate a whole image or dataset automatically. Starts a gating session: every marker is profiled and settled deterministically where the numbers suffice (a job), and the rest become decision packets for you, one at a time, through gating_next / gating_answer. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

Biology.description: The sample's biology as the user stated it (`autogate/biology.py`).

disease.description: The disease or sample type, in the user's words ('melanoma').

notes.description: Anything else the user said about the sample.

original.description: The user's note as written, when the fields above were read from it.

tissue.description: The tissue or organ, in the user's words ('skin', 'lymph node').

chars.description: Packet JSON characters per marker, over its looks.

images.description: Images per marker, over its looks.

packets.description: Looks per marker (first look, beside a reference, candidates); confirmations are free.

pixels.description: Image pixels per marker, over its looks.

ExpressionChoice.description: Which matrix to gate on, settled before the start.

basis.description: user: the user named it (applied over an earlier confirmed choice); inferred: a model read it from the values (applied only where nothing is confirmed).

features_log.description: Apply log1p as the values are read; never to values already logged.

absence_check.description: Before a marker's first look, ask whether six unmarked regions show any positive cell.

absence_confirm.description: A lone positive region of an absence picture is shown again close up before it counts.

agent.description: Who answers (your model's name); earlier answers are reused only from the same agent.

audit_sheet.description: Show automatically accepted markers on a batched audit sheet (~70 tokens a marker).

basic_qc.description: On an image with no QC result, run QC's model-free checks first (run_basic_qc) and leave out what they find. Default: on with v3 and v4, off with v1.

biology.description: The tissue and disease the user named: a prior, never a rule. Left out: from the project's metadata or inferred from the panel, marked so.

check_reading.description: How a classifier check's look is read (count: unmeasured).

classifier.description: The Single Cell Classifier beside each gate. layer: trained at each written gate, kept beside the threshold (which decides) until the user adopts it; check: also show the cells it disagrees on in a look; off.

defer_parents.description: A weakly separated marker waits for its children in the panel's hierarchy.

delegate.description: Return the `delegate` block: how to hand the packet loop to worker conversations.

display_check.description: Auto contrast for every look: vision (a contrast grid to the model, once per image), rule (the calibration's window), off. Default: off with engines v3 and v4, vision with v1.

engine.description: v3: blind panels of single cells labelled one at a time, code picks the candidate gate the labels support; v4: v3, a dataset's aligned images decided together (the default for scope=dataset); v1: rows below, at and above the gate. classic (v1), candidates and v2 (v3) are accepted.

evidence.description: delta: evidence this conversation was already sent comes as {as_in: packet_id}; full: every packet whole.

expression.description: The matrix to gate on, when the user named it or a model read it from the values; checked against the project's matrices.

field_um.description: The context sheet's tissue fields, microns a side.

force.description: Start when only some markers match an image channel: the rest are skipped (skipped_no_channel).

known_guide.description: The `guide_version` of a reading guide you hold: it is not sent again.

lanes.description: Readers answering at once, each its own `reader` passing `parallel`.

markers.description: Default: every marker except structural channels (DNA and the like).

max_extensions.description: Extra allowances one marker may get before review.

max_tier.description: 2: one look per marker; 3: + reference channels; 4: + candidate refinement; 5: + questions for the user.

mirror.description: Show each decision in an open viewer too.

mode.description: apply: gates are written as they are decided; propose: nothing is written until gating_session_finish(action=commit).

observations.description: Experimental. use: the contrast check's observations are evidence in every look.

on_limit.description: A marker out of looks while the evidence says go on: ask (the user; the marker waits), extend (another allowance), stop (review).

overwrite_manual.description: Also re-gate markers the user set by hand (never locked or approved ones).

panel_looks.description: Engines v3 and v4: the most cell panels a marker is shown before review.

purpose.description: gating: decide the gates; contrast: auto contrast only (contrast_session_start).

qc.description: QC failures left out of every fit and picture. strict: cells QC called exclude or warn, and per marker the cells QC flagged unreliable; exclude: warn calls kept; off: QC ignored (only when the user asks).

reading.description: once: the reading guide comes with the start (and the status, asked) and packets name its entries; every_packet: each packet repeats the texts it needs.

reference_image.description: Dataset scope: the image gated first (default: the one with the most cells).

replan.description: Re-plan when markers fail. False keeps the start's plan.

reuse_answers.description: Answer a packet identical to one this agent answered before with that answer. False asks afresh.

scope.description: project: one image; dataset: every image of a dataset, the reference image first and gates carried to the rest.

setup.description: When the gating set-up is unfinished (a column, the matrix). ask: a missing column refuses; the matrix comes as an expression_setup packet to put to the user, never guessed. fail: nothing starts; the error says what to supply. wait: the session waits in needs_setup until the user finishes the viewer's set-up form.

sheets.description: trim: context-sheet rows this conversation was already shown are left out; full: every sheet whole.

split_mixed.description: Split a candidate row judged mixed into finer ones and look again.

split_views.description: bright_rechecks: a recheck of a bright marker's gate draws each cell as DNA | marker | both (unmeasured).

tiles.description: Draw each look's cells as 2 x 2 blocks with two partner channels.

vision_first.description: Experimental: the looks place a weak marker's gate. Pair with observations=use.

whole_image_moves.description: A whole-image check calling the gate too low or too high sends it back to the candidates.

whole_image_reopen.description: A whole-image check calling the gate too low gives one more look at the candidates above.

descriptor.purpose: Gate a whole image or dataset automatically. Starts a gating session: every marker is profiled and settled deterministically where the numbers suffice (a job), and the rest become decision packets for you, one at a time, through gating_next / gating_answer.

tools.description: The session's next decision packet: one question, compact numbers, at most two small images, and the answer schema. The same packet again if it is still unanswered. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

parallel.description: The most packets of this session out at once, across every reader. Above 1, markers that do not depend on each other are handed out side by side; a marker still waits for the partners it is judged beside.

reader.description: Who is answering, when several conversations answer one session at once (one id per conversation). Omit when you are the only one.

rerender.description: Draw the outstanding packet's images again (same packet, same charge), in full: after a renderer change, or when you no longer hold a packet an `as_in` names.

tasks.description: The tasks this reader answers (`module.task`, from its brief): it is given only their packets, and `other_tasks` when what is ready is another task's. Omit to answer every packet.

wait_s.description: How long to wait for the bulk pass when nothing is ready yet.

descriptor.purpose: The session's next decision packet: one question, compact numbers, at most two small images, and the answer schema. The same packet again if it is still unanswered.

tools.description: Answer the outstanding packet with a typed judgement; the server moves the marker on (and writes its gate when it is decided) and returns the next packet. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

answer.description: The typed answer: `kind` plus the fields the packet's answer_schema lists.

include_next.description: Return the next packet with the outcome, saving a gating_next call.

model.description: The model you are running on, as your client names it: recorded with the answer, so the session can show which model answered each task.

parallel.description: The most packets of this session out at once, across every reader. Above 1, markers that do not depend on each other are handed out side by side; a marker still waits for the partners it is judged beside.

reader.description: Who is answering, when several conversations answer one session at once (one id per conversation). Omit when you are the only one.

tasks.description: The tasks this reader answers (`module.task`, from its brief): it is given only their packets, and `other_tasks` when what is ready is another task's. Omit to answer every packet.

descriptor.purpose: Answer the outstanding packet with a typed judgement; the server moves the marker on (and writes its gate when it is decided) and returns the next packet.

tools.description: A gating session: each marker's gate, state, confidence and why it needs review, its progress and what waits on the user (detail=full: everything else it holds); or the recent sessions. Can pause or resume it. Read-only. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

detail.description: brief: state, progress, counts, and each marker's gate, state, confidence and why it needs review; full: every unit's fields (the candidate gates the reads leave, the classifier layer), the budget spent, QC, biology, mirroring, the delegate block, the vocabulary and the reading guide.

guide.description: Send the reading guide packets point into (`evidence.guide`, `answer_schema.see`): once, before you answer packets yourself.

known_guide.description: The `guide_version` you hold: the reading guide is then not sent again.

limits.description: Answers to the session's limit questions (`requests` of a `waiting_for_user` result), by marker: `continue` grants another allowance, `stop` flags the marker for manual review. Pass the user's answer, not your own guess.

project.description: With reattach_viewer, in a dataset's session: the image the tab shows (default: what it reports); the packet replayed is that image's.

replay_mirror.description: With reattach_viewer: show the packet out in the viewer now, not at the next packet.

view_id.description: With reattach_viewer: the tab to mirror into (defaults to the one mirrored before).

descriptor.purpose: A gating session: each marker's gate, state, confidence and why it needs review, its progress and what waits on the user (detail=full: everything else it holds); or the recent sessions. Can pause or resume it.

tools.description: Finish a gating session: close it, commit a propose-mode session's gates, cancel its bulk pass, or roll back every gate it wrote. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

action.description: close: end the session (writes stay; a marker not yet settled is written at the best gate it reached, for review; a session the user stopped in the viewer is cancelled); commit: write a propose-mode session's accepted gates and empty gates; cancel: stop the bulk pass (writes stay); rollback: undo every write the session made, newest first.

descriptor.purpose: Finish a gating session: close it, commit a propose-mode session's gates, cancel its bulk pass, or roll back every gate it wrote.

tools.description: The review report of a gating session, HTML and/or PDF: per marker the final gate, the GMM proposal, confidence, flags, the distribution and the near-gate cells; for a dataset the spread across images. Read-only. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

descriptor.purpose: The review report of a gating session, HTML and/or PDF: per marker the final gate, the GMM proposal, confidence, flags, the distribution and the near-gate cells; for a dataset the spread across images.

tools.description: Render a gate check per field: A the raw marker, B the marker over nuclear grey with outlines and the gate's positive cells in magenta, C where the field's cells fall on the whole distribution -- with counts and the borderline cells by id. For judging a gate by eye. Read-only. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

classes.description: Which kinds of field to pick.

context_marker.description: A second channel drawn in cyan in panel B, e.g. a lineage marker.

field_size_px.description: Field side in pixels (default: the preset's pixel fallback, when it is not).

field_size_um.description: Field side in microns (default: the marker-validation preset's, when the image is calibrated).

fields.description: Fields from `sample_gate_validation_regions` (each with `bounds`); sampled here when omitted.

low.description: Gate to check (default: the stored one).

marker.description: A marker column, as `list_markers` names it.

qc.description: QC failures left out of this estimate, sample or picture (the gate still applies to every cell). strict (default): cells QC called exclude or warn, and the cells QC flagged this marker unreliable in; exclude: warn calls kept; off: QC ignored (only when the user asks).

descriptor.purpose: Render a gate check per field: A the raw marker, B the marker over nuclear grey with outlines and the gate's positive cells in magenta, C where the field's cells fall on the whole distribution -- with counts and the borderline cells by id. For judging a gate by eye.

tools.description: Quality-control an image automatically. Starts a QC session: every channel is scanned and candidate artifacts found deterministically (a job); you then audit every channel at a glance and judge the candidates, one packet at a time, through qc_next / qc_answer. Confirmed artifacts become ROIs, traced to the artifact's own pixels inside the outline you judged; cells get pass/fail. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

images.description: Images per candidate, over its looks.

packets.description: Looks per candidate (confirm, localise, grid); the audit and scope are free.

pixels.description: Image pixels per candidate, over its looks.

QCChecks.description:
The image checks a session runs first: each scores the tissue, you
judge places sampled across the score (`score_review`). One that cannot
run here is skipped and says why.

artifacts.description: The Artifact Detector: folds, tears, debris and saturation, one review per category.

blur.description: Blur QC on the nuclear channels.

blur_channels.description: The channels Blur QC scores (default: the session's nuclear channels, else every channel).

max_pixels.description: Skip Segmentation QC on an image of more full-resolution pixels than this.

registration.description: Registration Check of every nuclear channel against the reference.

segmentation.description: Segmentation QC, when the project has a mask: where too large, too small and irregular cells cluster.

visual.description: After the checks, one look at the whole tissue on which you outline large artifacts the detectors missed (segment_qc_roi).

agent.description: Who answers (your model's name); earlier answers are reused only from the same agent.

background_roi.description: Write the glass outside the feathered tissue as one "QC: Background" ROI (apply mode). Its cells are noted `background`, never excluded unless the user renames or approves it so.

channels.description: Default: every channel of the image.

checks.description: The image checks run first; you judge places sampled across their scores.

custom_thresholds.description: With strictness=custom: keys of the strictness table, each within the lenient..strict band.

known_guide.description: The `guide_version` of a reading guide you hold: it is not sent again.

map_cell_um.description: The scan's map cell, microns a side (default 50).

mirror.description: Show each decision in an open viewer too. null: on when one Plexora tab can be driven; true: ask for it; false: never.

mode.description: apply: confirmed regions are written as ROIs as they are decided (each receipted and undoable); propose: nothing is written until qc_session_finish(action=commit).

on_limit.description: A candidate out of looks while the evidence says go on: ask (the user), extend, or stop (manual review).

reading.description: once: the reading guide comes with the start (and the status, asked); every_packet: each packet repeats the texts it needs.

refine.description: Write each confirmed artifact's own pixels traced inside the outline you judged. false: the outline itself.

refine_margin_um.description: The margin grown round a traced artifact, microns (default: the class's own, 3-10).

reuse_answers.description: Answer a packet identical to one this agent answered before with that answer, without asking.

scope.description: One image (a dataset scope comes later).

strictness.description: How readily a confirmed artifact excludes cells. Changing it later re-derives every call without asking again.
